contract: v7 MEDULLA TIMING arm: PREREGISTRATION v2, frozen and committed before any v7 fit, held-out evaluation or S3 simulation (the only simulation so far is the one timed start-0 smoke evaluation required by the audits; no optimisation). Science card A (motion vision), 10 Oct 2026.
hypothesis: The v6 S3 null (T4/T5 0.33 mV, no direction selectivity) is caused by uncalibrated temporal properties of the T4/T5 input stage. If Mi1, Tm3 (ON) and Tm1, Tm2 (OFF), measured INSIDE the unchanged network, reproduce their published in vivo voltage filters, the frozen S3 motion test should pass.
label: EXPLORATORY. Inherits the S1-A3 photoreceptor stage (FIT REJECTED, held-out 2/4, TRANSFER FAIL) and the S2-A-leak40 lamina/medulla parameters (hypothetical). v7 adds the first held-out-testable medulla calibration; it never upgrades S1/S2. The hypothesis and the choice of types are POST HOC to the S3 null.

heldout.source: Behnia et al. 2014 Fig. 2 1 s flash column (digitised) + Extended Data Fig. 1c ratios from the text
heldout.isolation: read only by scripts/v7/heldout_v7.py, once, after the fitted parameter file is frozen and committed; fit_v7.py and v7_data.py never import or open it (tests/test_v7_medulla.py). WEAK and NON-INDEPENDENT: probably the same cells as training, values seen by the author; a held-out pass is a consistency check and is never claimed as validation.

data.split_rationale: training = flicker about a mean (adapted, linear-filter regime); held-out = flashes from darkness (step, rectification and amplitude regime). Same lab, not guaranteed different animals: the hold-out tests generalisation across stimulus class, not across preparations.

base_params.why: the exact parameter set the frozen S3 rerun1 tested, so v7 differs from the v6 comparator ONLY in the fitted entries below

free_parameters.tau: membrane time constant per type (graded single compartment); bounds = the S2 bounds
free_parameters.leak_rest: leak reversal per recorded type, bounds = the pooled resting range -70..-40 mV used in S2 (Behnia held cells near -60 mV); rest, leak reversal and E_inh (-70 mV, global) stay distinct
free_parameters.gain: EFFECTIVE linear release gain of L1 and L2 (the main presynaptic types of Mi1/Tm3 and Tm1/Tm2), a per-type presynaptic quantity; never a weight. Sets the absolute mV scale the S2 calcium fit could not see. Its amplitude target uses the resolved scale convention (observation_model.filter_stim_scale) and is cross-checked by gate A5 against a directly measured mV response; there is no free scale parameter.
free_parameters.graded_release: release FUNCTION stays as in v6: linear for L1/L2 and for Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 (gain 1). The recorded cells' own output release is NOT identifiable from somatic voltage and is not fitted; a sigmoid for L1/L2 is not identifiable from linear filters (rectification is held-out territory). Both are disclosed non-identifiable and fixed.
free_parameters.fixed: graph and every edge/base weight (graph 4b2f87cc...091d01); R1-R6 phototransduction and release (S1-A3); L1/L2 Ih and e_leak (-40, leak40); L3, L4, L5, Mi4, Mi9, Tm4, Tm9 and all other types as in the base file
free_parameters.side_effects: L1/L2 tau and gain also change the drive of Mi4, Mi9, Tm4, Tm9, C3 and other L1/L2 targets onto T4/T5, beyond the four recorded types.

stimulus.fit_cutout: the frozen S2 7-column cutout (scripts/v6/fit_s2.build_cutout: central right-eye column (17,27) + 6 neighbours; 13 lamina/medulla types + R1-R6; no T4/T5; external inputs absent, disclosed)
stimulus.noise: full-field (all cutout R1-R6 equal): encoder = 10 (1 + s(t)), s from v7_data.behnia_noise
stimulus.mean_luminance_mapping: Behnia's 250 cd m^-2 mean is mapped to BG-1 (encoder 10, the S2 and S3 gray). ASSUMPTION, not a measurement; disclosed risk (adaptation sets filter speed).
stimulus.heldout_flash: dark (encoder 0) 3000 ms settle, 1000 ms pre, 1000 ms at encoder 20 (= 2m), 1500 ms post; offset window 727 ms (heldout_v7.py)

observation_model.readout: somatic V (mV) of the central-column Mi1, Tm3, Tm1, Tm2 (v6 is single-compartment: soma = cell); 1 ms samples
observation_model.transform: 0.008 Hz first-order high-pass, then the data's own estimator against u = 0.5 c (the paper's plotted intensity deviation; data pin v2 scale_convention): K(w)=<R U*>/(<U U*>+eps), 5 s zero-padded snippets every 100 ms, eps = 1 % of mean <U U*>, lags 0-219 ms (v7_data.observe_filter). No calcium, no normalisation.
observation_model.objective: mean over the 4 types of mean over lags 0-219 ms of ((K_model - K_data)/sigma_t)^2, sigma_t = max(sqrt(sem_t^2 + sigma_dig^2), sigma_floor)
observation_model.scale_convention: resolved, not fitted: digitised filter (x) Fig. 3a stimulus as u reproduces the paper's predicted trace with slope 1.03/1.09/1.00 (Mi1/Tm1/Tm2). Not a nuisance parameter; nothing is tuned to it.
observation_model.response_sd: v7_data.response_sd: s.d. of the high-passed somatic V over the 10 s noise after 250 ms (gate A5 only)

optimiser.method: scipy Powell, bounded, transformed parameters (log for log-scale)
optimiser.start_0: base values (tau from the base file, e_leak -52 where unset, gain 1)
optimiser.starts_1_3: Latin hypercube in the transformed box
optimiser.selection: among COMPLETED starts whose own gates give TRAIN_PASS, the lowest training objective; tie -> lowest start index (fit_v7.outcome). Gates are evaluated per start, on that start's own parameters.
optimiser.resources: CPU only, no GPU; one process per start, 4 processes, NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1, nice, taskset -c 0-3
optimiser.completion: a start is completed when Powell returns and its report is written; a start killed at the 3 h wall cap or crashed is NOT EVALUABLE and never counts as a failed start

compute_budget.fit: MEASURED (smoke, start 0, real 97-cell cutout, one process): __EVAL_S__ s per evaluation; 3000 evaluations x 4 starts in 4 parallel processes = __FIT_COREH__ core-h, ~__FIT_WALLH__ h wall; hard cap 3 h wall per start
compute_budget.s3: 4 CPU processes x ~2.3 h (rerun1: 8312-8416 s each) = ~9.3 core-h, ~2.3 h wall on 4 cores
compute_budget.total: ~__TOTAL_COREH__ core-h (fit + S3 9.3 + full-network filter diagnostic ~1.1), at <= 4 cores
compute_budget.network_filter_diagnostic: one full-brain 16 s CPU simulation (~300 s wall per simulated s from rerun1) ~1.3 h, single process

training.A1: per-type NRMSE(K_model, K_data) <= 0.35 for all four types
training.A2: |model peak - digitised peak| <= 2 x text s.e.m. + 5 ms, all four
training.A3: peak(Mi1) - peak(Tm3) >= 5 ms AND peak(Tm1) - peak(Tm2) >= 5 ms
training.A4: main-lobe polarity: the model filter's largest-|value| lag has the correct sign AND the model sign at the data peak lag is correct, all four
training.TRAIN_PASS: A1 and A2 and A3 and A4 and A5, evaluated on each start's own parameters (v7_data.train_gates)
training.A5: convention-free amplitude: model response s.d. (mV) within a factor 1.5 of the Fig. 3a measured s.d., all four (a gate, never an objective term)

heldout.H1: polarity: Mi1/Tm3 depolarise at onset and hyperpolarise at offset; Tm1/Tm2 the reverse; all four
heldout.H2: weak/strong ratio within text mean +/- 3 s.e.m. (ranges above); >= 3 of 4
heldout.H3: strong-polarity flash peak (mV, convention-free) within a factor 1.5 of the digitised Fig. 2 value; >= 3 of 4
heldout.label: WEAK, NON-INDEPENDENT consistency check (probably the same cells; values seen by the author). Never reported as validation.
heldout.v1_change: v1 used +/- 2 population s.d. (Tm3 0-81.6 %) and x2; tightened

sequence: 0 smoke: one timed start-0 evaluation on the real cutout (done before freezing v2; cost measured, no optimisation)
1 fit: 4 starts in parallel -> fit_v7.outcome -> if TRAIN_PASS commit params_v7.json and its sha256 (frozen)
2 held-out consistency once on the frozen file -> report
3 full-network filter diagnostic on the frozen file (no fitting, no gate) -> report
5 v7 S3 addendum committed (params sha, evidence dir) -> S3 (run_s3_v7.py) -> guard parts -> merge -> guard merged -> analyse -> gates; reported whatever they show

downstream_s3.protocol: UNCHANGED frozen S3 prereg qualification/v6/S3_prereg.json (9658283e...) and addendum 1 (ac445682...): same runner, encoder, lattices (axial-v1 and malecns-hex-v2, both reported), conditions dir0-dir315 + yaw_ccw/yaw_cw, windows, analysis and gates G1-G3/EXPLORATORY_PASS. The only change is --params params_v7.json --params-sha256 <frozen sha>, recorded in a v7 S3 addendum committed before launch.
downstream_s3.command: for arm in axial-v1 malecns-hex-v2; for part in A B: NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= nice taskset -c 0-3 <python> scripts/v7/run_s3_v7.py --prereg-v2 qualification/v7/V7_medulla_prereg_v2.json --prereg-v2-sha256 <this file> --params qualification/v7/params_v7.json --params-sha256 <frozen> --lattice $arm --part $part --outdir <evidence-root>/flybrain-v7-evidence-<date>/S3_v7  (4 processes in parallel; it runs measure_tuning_v6.py with tag v7_<arm>_<part>, conditions A: dir0,dir45,dir90,dir135,yaw_ccw | B: dir180,dir225,dir270,dir315,yaw_cw)

v6_leak40_rerun1.note: merged S3 rerun1 NPZs, reused, not rerun; read FIRST (same backend, differs from v7 only in the fitted entries)

comparators_cpu.v5_gpu: reused descriptively only (66e23cd4..., 6581312a...); no new GPU job

environment.preflight: scripts/v7/run_s3_v7.py verifies cwd, graph sha (resolved), connectome_data, package versions, params sha and every unchanged_sha256 before launching the unchanged runner; exit 3 and nothing launched on any mismatch

merge: scripts/v6/merge_parts.py <A> v7_<arm> v7_<arm>_A v7_<arm>_B (each arm)
merged == parts array check as rerun1

engine_diff_vs_rerun1.files: brainlab/brain.py, brainlab/graph_identity.py (plus new brainlab/flywire.py, cosim_server.py, datasets.json, FlyWire pin files) from origin/master 6fdff74
engine_diff_vs_rerun1.effect_on_malecns: none on the S3 path: brain.py adds a raise only when n == 139,255 (FlyWire 783) inside _v3_policy_weight (v3 only; S3 uses v4/v6 dynamics, n = 166,700); graph_identity adds a refusal only when the graph manifest declares a dataset_id other than malecns_v1, and the MaleCNS manifest declares none. brainlab/v6_calibrated.py, engine.py and the runner are byte-identical to rerun1.

rules: No parameter, bound, start, objective, gate, window, data file or analysis change after any fit output is seen; a crash rerun is recorded with its reason; all starts, both lattice arms and all comparators are reported whatever they show. No GPU. <= 4 CPU cores.

supersedes.status: SUPERSEDED before any fit; kept byte-identical
supersedes.reason: audit 1 REJECT-as-frozen (F-a..F-e) and audit 2 conditions (C1-C3): ~2x filter-scale convention, ambiguous start selection vs TRAIN_PASS, NOT-EVALUABLE vs F1, weak held-out gates, S3 guard/environment not preregistered, missing risks, extrapolated compute

outcomes.NOT_EVALUABLE: fewer than 2 of 4 starts completed (cap or crash): no claim, no S3; report and stop
outcomes.F1_representation: at least 2 starts completed and none reaches TRAIN_PASS: the network as modelled cannot reproduce the measured Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 timing and amplitude with per-type tau/leak/L-gain alone. Arm stops; no S3.
outcomes.TRAIN_PASS: the selected start (fit_v7.outcome) is frozen; held-out consistency and the full-network filter diagnostic are reported; S3 only with owner go
outcomes.F2_consistency: TRAIN_PASS but HELDOUT_CONSISTENT false: reported as 'held-out consistency FAIL'; S3 may still run with owner go, labelled so
outcomes.F3_main: TRAIN_PASS (and whatever HELDOUT_CONSISTENT shows, reported alongside), yet EXPLORATORY_PASS false on BOTH lattice arms: calibrated input-stage timing is not sufficient for direction selectivity in this model; 'uncalibrated medulla timing caused the S3 null' is FALSIFIED.
outcomes.support_not_proof: EXPLORATORY_PASS on >= 1 arm after TRAIN_PASS: an exploratory observation needing independent replication (a second, independent mV source); held-out consistency is not validation.

network_filter_diagnostic.what: non-motion re-measurement of the four filters in the FULL network (the S3 BrainV6 on graph 4b2f87cc with params_v7, both eyes' R1-R6 driven by the same full-field Behnia noise, seed 1, 3 s gray settle + 10 s), readout = the right-eye central-column (17,27) Mi1/Tm3/Tm1/Tm2 per the Path B column map (b61741d2...), same observation model
network_filter_diagnostic.use: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY: NRMSE/peaks vs the data and vs the cutout fit are reported before S3; no gate, no fitting, cannot change the parameters
network_filter_diagnostic.implementation: script frozen in the v7 S3 addendum before it runs

risks: scale convention: resolved from Fig. 3a (slope ~1 against u = c/2); residual risk that the true stimulus s.d. was 0.25 (A5/H3 would show it)
luminance mapping: Behnia's ~250 cd m^-2 mean -> BG-1 (encoder 10) is assumed, not measured; adaptation sets filter speed
flash mapping: 'intensity 1 = 2x mean' (encoder 20) and darkness = encoder 0 are assumptions; 3 s dark settle vs an unknown inter-flash interval
single model cell fitted to a POPULATION-AVERAGED filter (Mi1 cell peaks 56-85 ms): averaging broadens the target and biases fitted tau slower

fit in the 7-column cutout (external inputs absent) but deployed in the full network: only the descriptive full-network filter diagnostic checks the fitted timing in the S3 context; no network-level gate
display/acquisition latency (DLP, fibre optic) is unmodelled: absolute peak times (A2) include it
held-out data are probably the same cells and were seen by the author: weak, non-independent
inputs inherit the REJECTED S1-A3 photoreceptor stage; leak40 is hypothetical
L1/L2 tau/gain trade off against the medulla tau (correlated, possibly non-identifiable); L1/L2 changes reach other T4/T5 inputs
fitted values may sit on bounds (as in S2)
the hypothesis and type choice are post hoc to the S3 null (EXPLORATORY)
the clean base differs from rerun1 by FlyWire-only guards (disclosed above)
